## History

Maria lived at Patty's Place alongside Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) and was the niece of [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) Spofford. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visited Maria and Patty's Place, where they successfully arranged to rent the house from the two women for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P27](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0027), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

## Relationships

### [Patty](../character/patty.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Maria and [Patty](../character/patty.md) are companions who travel abroad together. They jointly manage Patty's Place, agreeing to rent the house to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), +4 more_
